title: Issa Rae Sets HBO Pilot About Male Friendship and Pro Boxers in Las Vegas
content: 10 years after Issa Rae’s seminal comedy series “Insecure” premiered on HBO, the network has ordered a new comedy pilot written and executive produced by Rae. Currently known as “Untitled Male Friendship Show,” the project is set in the world of professional boxing in Las Vegas. More to come…
